summary: The United States has redirected 133 commercial vessels to enforce a blockade against Iran while the Pentagon drafts attack options targeting Iranian military infrastructure. Israel eliminated two Hamas commanders in Gaza linked to hostage holding and conducted a drone strike near the Lebanon-Syria border injuring six. Houthi forces are escalating attacks on Saudi airports and threatening Red Sea shipping, prompting Saudi Arabia to request Italian military assistance.
key_points: US CENTCOM confirmed redirection of 133 commercial vessels since October 9 to enforce Iran blockade, signaling sustained maritime interdiction. (Source: @shin_persian/10890)

IDF eliminated Hamas Shati Battalion commander Muhammad Muhsin Namir Yazji in Gaza City and Draj Tufah militant Muhammad Fuzi Muhammad Awad Jamal in Sabra, both linked to hostage holding. (Source: @New_security8200/204158)
Israeli drone strike near Lebanon-Syria border injured six people including five Syrian nationals and one Lebanese citizen. (Source: @presstv/210194)
Houthi forces relentlessly attacking Saudi airports to sever kingdom's global air links per Wall Street Journal, while Sanaa threatens Red Sea shipping blockade. (Source: @N12chat/229310)
Saudi Arabia formally requested Italian military aid to counter Yemeni attacks, confirmed by Italian Defense Ministry. (Source: @SharghDaily/188459)
IRGC released footage of Shahed-136/238 drones striking US targets during Operations Nasr 1, Nasr 2, and Punishing the Aggressor. (Source: @naya_foriraq/93108)

Israeli assassination of IRGC Navy Commander Alireza Tangsiri followed US CENTCOM chief Brad Cooper's request to Israeli COS Eyal Zamir over Strait of Hormuz concerns. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/398387)
Armed attacks killed Faryab County police chief in Kerman province with several similar attacks on Iranian security forces in southeast Iran over two days. (Source: @VahidOnline/78666)

points: US CENTCOM confirmed redirection of 133 commercial vessels as of October 9 to enforce a blockade against Iran, indicating sustained maritime pressure on Iranian oil and trade routes. (Source: @shin_persian/10890)

Former President Trump claimed US "total control" of the Strait of Hormuz and announced a Russian agreement to supply 300,000 tons of diesel immediately, 500,000 tons in November, and up to 3 million tons subsequently. (Source: @shin_persian/10894)
